claim: The linked reference defines progressive edge blur behavior, not a complete redesign of screen layouts.
Each decorative edge overlay should be owned by the nearest relevant scroll surface, pass touches through, and retain the fast-scroll gradient fallback.
Native behavior parity is feasible, but SDK57 compatibility and identical cross-platform pixels are not established by public documentation.
The effect needs a legible accessibility fallback, including an opaque surface fade under iOS Reduce Transparency and sufficient Android text contrast.
Native visual and performance behavior needs device verification because the platform compositing/rendering paths differ and can be hardware-sensitive.
